messages:
alice: FYI customer beta-corp reporting SCIM provisioning failures after SSO onboarding. SCIM returns HTTP 500 for new users.
raj: which IdP? Azure AD?
alice: yes Azure AD (tenant: beta-corp). SAML login works, but SCIM push fails inside our private connector. logs: "scim-handler: 500 internal - failed to fetch service account key"
tanya: that sounds like a key lookup/permission issue, not a SAML assertion problem. can we see KMS/IAM audit for scim-provisioner-sa?
mika: pulling logs: noticed a 403 on KMS.getKey for service-account@beta-corp at 02:12 UTC then several 500s following. also saw an IAM policy change at 02:10 UTC by deploy-bot.
ops-bot: Deploy event: stackdriver-deploy/2026-03-05T02:09Z rolled RBAC patch pr#1589 to private connectors (author: infra-ci).
alice: pr#1589 limited long-lived service account permissions as part of least-privilege work. Did it remove kms.getKey from scim-provisioner-sa?
raj: check policy diff...
raj: diff: removed binding roles/kms.viewer from group:connector-services, replaced with roles/kms.encryptOnly at resource level. That would block getKey/Decrypt.
tanya: ok that explains KMS 403. Why did it surface as 500 on SCIM? Our connector swallows KMS error and returns 500 upstream. need better error mapping.
mika: customer shows backlog: 120 provisioning requests failed, some duplicates. beta-corp is on Private in eu-west1.
idp-bot: SAML assertions validated for beta-corp; groups sync looks normal. This is post-authz provisioning step.
alice: immediate mitigation: re-grant roles/kms.viewer to scim-provisioner-sa for beta-corp's connector. raj can you patch IAM?
raj: done via infra-runbook: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:scim-provisioner-sa@beta-corp --role=roles/kms.viewer (applied at 02:28 UTC).
ops-bot: policy binding applied by raj at 02:28 UTC.
alice: provisioning resumed for beta-corp after 02:30 UTC, customer confirms. backlog drained.
security: we need to treat this as a security/availability incident. RBAC change caused outage. add toSEC tracker.
tanya: postmortem notes: - re-evaluate pr#1589 changes, - add automated canary for RBAC changes in private connectors, - update connector error handling to surface KMS 403 as 5xx with telemetry.aj: root cause: RBAC tighten removed kms get permissions; secondary cause: deploy rolled to eu-west1 connectors without staged policy.
infra: action: create a preflight check that validates connector service accounts have required roles before RBAC deploy.
security: also run vuln triage on connector token refresh path; ensure no secrets leaked during failure.
mika: customer-bot: beta-corp says minimal user impact, thanks for quick rollback.
alice: thanks everyone. I'll draft customer note and postmortem. tagging @infra @ops to schedule RBAC preflight.
ops-bot: follow-up ticket created: INF-2026-052 (RBAC preflight + connector error mapping).
security: assigned SEC-2026-021 to review least-privilege rollout checklist. ETA end of day.
alice: closing thread once postmortem is published. last observed success 02:34 UTC.
